name: song-board-pinned-own-id
note: Issue #197: the pinned 'your rank' row has its own UIA element (fst.song-leaderboard.spotlight-footer), not a second copy of the player's list-row ID, so Narrator and UIA reach the list row and the pinned row as two distinct targets: the list row in rank order, the pinned row after every row and before the pager.

name: song-board-empty-total
note: Issue #197: an empty board (Bass: no entries, showLeaderboardEntryTotals true, totalEntries 0) never says '0 Bass entries' (web LeaderboardPage totalEntries > 0). The header reads title, artist and instrument only, the title stays heading 1, the empty state reads after the header, and no pager or pinned row is exposed.
after_ready: assertread:id=fst.song-leaderboard.song|Fixture Pulse, Synthetic Quartet, Bass, button, Opens Song Details

name: song-board-contrast-plate
note: Issue #197: under a contrast theme the footer fade is a hard cut and a Window-colour plate backs the pinned row and pager, so no row text (Desert WindowText #3D3D3D) shows beside the pager buttons or between the pinned row and the pager mid-scroll; the pinned row and pager keep their names, 40x40 targets and order.

name: song-board-name-tooltip
note: Issue #197: with motion off (in-app Reduce Motion stops the name marquee) a row name too long for its column ellipsizes, Narrator still reads it in full, and keyboard focus on the row shows the full name as a tool tip; a row whose name fits has none.
after_ready: assertread:id=fst.song-leaderboard.row.fixture-player-2|~^Rank #2, Fixture Player With An Extraordinarily Long Display Name That Never Fits, .+, button$
assertread:class=ToolTip|Fixture Player With An Extraordinarily Long Display Name That Never Fits, tool tip
